But easier: use du with human_readable=True, then write that string plus " bytes"? But requirement: "數字後面跟著字詞 bytes，並且沒有其他內容." So maybe just "12345 bytes". We can get size in bytes by du without human_readable? That returns bytes. Let\'s call du with human_readable=False. Then write f"{size} bytes". Let\'s do that.')
